shellCommands.command:
(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "=== timing to first byte / full ==="; curl -s -o /tmp/product.html -w "ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s\n" http://localhost:3111/product; echo "=== does shell contain title? ==="; grep -o '

Premium Widget

' /tmp/product.html; echo "=== order of shell vs streamed content ==="; grep -o -e '

Premium Widget

' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' /tmp/product.html

cd /workspace; echo "=== prefetch payload (what Link fetches on hover/render) ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -w "
ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s
" http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/pf.rsc; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.rsc && echo "title present in prefetch: YES"; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.rsc || echo "inventory NOT in prefetch (correct - stays dynamic)"; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -w "ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s
" -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/product; echo "=== prerendered shell on disk ==="; ls .next/server/app/product* 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace; for f in .next/server/app/product.segments/_full.segment.rsc .next/server/app/product.segments/_tree.segment.rsc; do echo "=== $f ($(stat -c%s $f) bytes) ==="; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' "$f" | sort -u; done; echo "=== nested segments ==="; find .next/server/app/product.segments -type f | head; echo "=== prerendered shell HTML ==="; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' .next/server/app/product.html | sort -u

cd /workspace; echo "=== segment prefetch (Next 16 shape) ==="; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full' -w "\nttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s\n" http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/seg.rsc; echo "bytes: $(stat -c%s /tmp/seg.rsc)"; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' /tmp/seg.rsc | sort -u

cd /workspace; echo "=== status+headers for segment prefetch ==="; curl -s -D- -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full' http://localhost:3111/product | head -20; echo "=== plain RSC (no prefetch header) ==="; curl -s -D- -H 'RSC: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/rsc2 | head -12; echo "bytes: $(stat -c%s /tmp/rsc2)"; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'in stock' /tmp/rsc2 | sort -u

cd /workspace; echo "=== segment prefetch (following redirect) ==="; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch: /_full' -w "
ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s
" http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/seg.rsc; echo "bytes: $(stat -c%s /tmp/seg.rsc)"; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' /tmp/seg.rsc | sort -u; echo; echo "=== full dynamic RSC nav payload (following redirect) ==="; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -w "ttfb=%{time_starttransfer}s total=%{time_total}s
" http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/rsc2; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Loading inventory' -e 'in stock' /tmp/rsc2 | sort -u

cd /workspace; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff (build auto-edits this) ==="; git diff -- tsconfig.json | head -20; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff -- package.json
cd /workspace; git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff -- tsconfig.json; echo "=== package.json diff ==="; git diff -- package.json
